errors.error_description: The combinational always block omits blended23/gated_d3 dependencies from its sensitivity list while reading them, causing a mismatch between read signals and listed sensitivities.
A clocked always block includes a level-sensitive data/control signal (sel) in its sensitivity list alongside posedge clk, mixing combinational and sequential behavior.
The input port 'test_mode' is driven internally by a continuous assignment, violating port direction and net/variable driving rules.
The submodule 'tiny_mux2' drives an 8-bit output port connected to a 4-bit net in the parent instance, creating a port width mismatch at the module boundary.
